note: One legato trill, one pick and then the fretting hand alone, on three pairs of fingers: a choice per pair (intermediate 2 and 4, advanced 2 and 3, advanced 3 and 4), each with its legato-trill props in `set`, its tempo in moves and the two fingers as the {{=lower}} and {{=upper}} params. Folds in guitar-advanced-hammer-and-pull-fingers-2-and-3 and guitar-advanced-hammer-and-pull-fingers-3-and-4. One block: the drill, the goal, and a care line.

exercise.title: Hammer and pull, fingers {{=lower}} and {{=upper}}
exercise.why: A pulled-off note is sounded by the finger leaving the string, so a trill on two fingers with no picking trains the finger that hammers on to pull off as firmly as it lands.

cells.text:
Press Play below to start the metronome at {{=bpm}}, and follow the tab. Pick the first note once, then hammer finger {{=upper}} on and pull it off to finger {{=lower}}, one note per beat, with no more picking.
Practice until the pulled-off note sounds as loud as the hammered one.
_Rest your hand when it gets tired, then go again._
